text:
Alex Chen: Quick sync - following up on the pin metadata proto. I want a compact deprecation signal + a tiny staging tier. Sketching API before I open a proto PR.
Maria Gonzalez: Sounds good. Can we keep the resolver hot path cheap? Extra field reads slow lookups in the hot path.
Samir Patel: Client semantics matter more than the shape. Do we want immediate fallbacks or a graded decay? I prefer an integer score clients can act on instead of parsing dates.
Jordan (eng-arch): Agreed. Implementation notes: encode small fields as bitflags/enums in the proto to avoid long strings. Prefer relative durations (_after_secs) to avoid clock sync problems.
Alex Chen: Proposed minimal rollout metadata to store with pins (compact binary on disk, expanded by resolver):
```proto
message RolloutMetadata {
  oneof timing {
    uint32 soft_deprecate_after_secs = 1; // relative, optional
    string soft_deprecate_iso = 2; // fallback human-readable
  }
  enum StagingTier { STABLE = 0; CANARY = 1; SHADOW = 2; }
  StagingTier staging_tier = 3;
  uint32 compat_bucket = 4; // 0..7, client heuristic
  string rollback_hint = 5; // application-visible tag
  // bitflags reserved for future tiny signals
}
```
Alex Chen: Notes: - resolver stores a compact 6-byte header for most pins (flags + compat_bucket + tier) - expand only when requested by management UI or client with verbose flag.
resolver-bot: Scheduled: pin-resolver v3 -> rollout window 02:30-03:30 UTC.
Maria Gonzalez: Migration: default compat_bucket=4 for older pins; resolver should ignore unknown fields to be forward-compatible. Also emit a metric when a pin has soft_deprecate set so we can alert regressions.
Samir Patel: For client litmus tests: define behavior when compat_bucket <= 2 -> immediate fallback; 3-4 -> probabilistic fallback (10-30%); >=5 -> no fallback. Add this to the SDK README so app owners know expectations.
Jordan (eng-arch): Also make sure the API surface exposes both iso and after_secs variants for human ops vs deterministic client behaviour.
Alex Chen: I'll open a proto PR with the compact encoding + a tiny migration plan and include a short litmus test script. Will tag you all and attach a resolver perf benchmark.
Maria Gonzalez: Awesome. One more ask: add a short entry to the rollout playbook describing rollback_hint semantics (how ops can tag a safe target).
Alex Chen: Will add. Thanks all :+1:
